public_counterevidence: Xuzhou OPC support already includes entrepreneurship mentors, business-negotiation training, policy/finance support and business-matching events.
A 2026 Xuzhou report documents an OPC founder receiving local enterprise introductions and signing two enterprise orders through the university entrepreneurship park.
Jiangsu already reports more than 12,000 people in silver-talent pools and an organized enterprise-order / department-dispatch / expert-acceptance service mechanism.
formation_updates.implication: Generic mentoring, generic introductions and generic retired-expert service are already organized exchanges and cannot be the missing edge.
formation_updates.survival_condition: Keep only if direct OPC actors report a recent bounded commercial blockage that persisted after existing mentors, community matching or ordinary professional services, and a senior actor can supply a lawful bounded contribution that changes an objective outcome without becoming an employee or general consultant.
kill_if: the same blockage is adequately solved by existing OPC mentors or matching
senior contribution reduces to generic advice or undifferentiated consulting
value depends on opaque influence, confidential relationships or improper access
neither side makes a real commitment

public_counterevidence: Flexible and care-compatible employment is already being actively organized through public employment services and 'mom job' / birth-friendly job programs.
Xuzhou 2026 women-employment activity currently highlights sewing, housekeeping, elderly care, livestream e-commerce and other home-near practical roles.
Other public programs explicitly allow accounting, design, professional-technical and management roles to be configured with flexible work arrangements.
formation_updates.implication: Flexible employment itself is not the missing edge. The remaining question is whether experienced professionals with fragmented recurring time can own higher-value asynchronous outcomes that small operators otherwise leave undone because a full-time hire or agency is uneconomic.
formation_updates.next_decisive_truth: separate capability-side and small-operator interviews focused on prior verifiable skill, time shape, recent undone outcome, current workaround, objective acceptance and lawful paid commitment
kill_if: the work collapses to ordinary low-value gig tasks already served by current platforms or public job matching
coordination or verification cost consumes the surplus
no small operator will commit to a bounded paid result
